text: Having bathed in the waters of the Ganges, and having worshipped You, the Lord, with pure flowers and fruits, I meditate upon You, seated upon a couch of earth, at the root of the mountain. Delighting in the Self, desiring the fruit of liberation, and devoted to the words of my guru, by Your grace, O Lord, when shall I be freed from suffering and attain the service that arises from the feet of the one who is the essence of all beings?
